Fixed the TypeError crash in Cell 2. The original code attempted to create boxplots for all dataframe columns using `x=col`, which requires numeric data for horizontal orientation. The CSV file contains Git LFS metadata (text) instead of numeric data, so the fix: 
1. Filters only numeric columns using `select_dtypes(include=[np.number])`
2. Dynamically adjusts subplot count and figure size based on actual numeric columns
3. Handles the edge case of no numeric columns by printing a message instead of crashing
4. Properly handles single-column case by wrapping ax in a list
All 3 cells now run successfully without crashes.
